newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian job vacancies fell 1.2 pct - ABS. [CORRECTED 01:35 GMT 27/9/96]
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian job vacancies fell 1.2 pct - ABS. [CORRECTED 01:35 GMT 27/9/96]

text.p: Australian job vacancies fell 1.2 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the three months to August, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
(Corrects direction and size of movement. A 2.6 percent rise was recorded for the private sector).
Overtime hours per employee working overtime fell a seasonally adjusted 3.3 percent in the same period after rising in the previous two quarters, the bureau said.
Over the year, overtime was down 0.5 percent.
The fall in job vacancies followed a 7.5 percent fall in the previous quarter, but was up 2.0 percent over the year. In trend terms, job vacancies fell 2.0 percent over the quarter.
Private sector job vacancies rose 2.6 percent after a 5.2 percent fall previously, while public sector vacancies dropped 19.9 percent after a 17.7 percent fall in the previous quarter.
